title: Sentinel-2 TrueColor (TEST)
description: TEST COLLECTION -- not for production use. Exercises the dps-output-discover Lambda end to end: routing, relocation into ProgramData/, and the veda_discover DAG trigger. Discovers from ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TestTrueColor/, shared with its subdaily counterpart -- the two are told apart by filename_regex exactly as sentinel2-truecolor-daily and -subdaily are. The prefix deliberately does NOT begin with 'TrueColor': sentinel2-truecolor-daily declares the slash-less prefix ProgramData/Sentinel-2/TrueColor, so any TrueColor* folder is claimed by that collection too. Matches merged scenes, which are written _day.tif and carry datetime_range 'day'. The dps-output-discover routing table must list this collection and declare that same dest_prefix. Safe to delete once the pipeline is verified.
